title: IEQ Occupant Index: software, design artifacts, and aggregated usability study data
description: Reference implementation, prototype build, design artifacts (personas, information architecture, study protocol), and aggregated counts-only usability study data (codebook, code frequencies, co-occurrence, heuristic evaluation, findings log) supporting the manuscript 'The Indoor Environmental Quality Occupant Index: A Role-Tiered Tool for Channeling Anonymous Occupant Feedback into Green Building Certification Decisions', submitted to Intelligent Buildings International. Contains no participant quotations, session notes, or personal data.
